scope: R2 only; R3 real visual approval gate remains with parent
caveats: Inventory and future URL proposals only. No migration, redirect, iframe removal, runtime compatibility, visual approval, full-site rollout, commit, main checkout access or push.
Source is the sealed baseline Git object tree. Newly created R3 previews/tests and untracked files are deliberately excluded.

All 146 baseline HTML files are inventoried. Every parsed static href and iframe attribute and every onclick handler is retained; JavaScript extraction is a conservative candidate scan, not arbitrary-code execution or complete data-flow resolution.
All baseline JS/MJS/CJS files (including bundles and tests) are scanned. Literal-only candidates may be assets, composed suffixes or test fixtures, and are labeled separately from actual HTML links.
Static anchor absence is uncertain because runtime-generated IDs and fragment routers exist. External services, repository project Pages and HTTP availability are not verified by local path checks.
Preserve benchmark/card and native demo designs. Inventory counts are repository metadata, not newly measured model benchmark results.
No assumed translations: paired files need declared-language/link evidence, in-page dictionaries need review, and lang=en on a Chinese resource does not translate it.
Stable content IDs derive from baseline paths, independent of sort order or file edits. Carry these IDs forward if paths are migrated; do not regenerate identities from new paths.

evidence.subject: Language query, history replacement and frame rerender

studioContract.initialLanguage: lang=en selects English; every other/missing initial value becomes zh-CN
studioContract.trackSelection: Recognized first hash segment wins; otherwise recognized query track wins; otherwise infra
studioContract.stageSyntax: #track/stage-N with N=1..4 is supported; #track/stage/N is NOT stage syntax and falls back to stage 1
studioContract.moduleSelection: Known ID within active track replaces selected module; unknown ID retains default/previous selection and falls back to stage 1 for known hash track
studioContract.selectionPersistence: Per-track Map initialized to first non-report (cards.html|benchmark-cards heuristic), not HTML active button; retained until reload
studioContract.directory: #studio-directory scrolls directory but still selects fallback/query track and loads its default scene
studioContract.languageLocalization: Adds lang query to same-origin resources; only workshops/ai-security index/benchmark-cards and three root pages (benchmarks, ai-security, security-ai-landing-zone) change filenames. Commerce .en files exist but are not selected by this resolver.
studioContract.frames: mountStudio resets seven frames to about:blank. renderRoute replaces active frame with localized selected URL and blanks inactive frames; openCurrentStage opens native localized URL in new tab.
studioContract.history: navigate updates hash; hashchange rerenders; setLang uses history.replaceState; popstate reloads language from query. No static studio pages are implemented by this inventory.
